attribute_fields.COMMENTS: Missouri military retirement pay exclusion. Full exemption for all military retirement income (Group B). Special provision: National Guard/Reserve drill pay also excluded. Active duty, Reserve, and Guard pay exempt. MSRRA compliant. SCRA compliant. SBP payments fully exempt. NEEDS AUTHORSHIP: skeleton table — only stub "no exclusion" action present; conditions and full exclusion logic not yet implemented.

action_details.action_comment: No military retirement pay - no exclusion
action_details.action_dsl: set result.mo_military_retirement_exclusion = 0; add " No military retirement pay - no exclusion" to job.audit_trail

attribute_fields.COMMENTS: Calculates Missouri state income tax per Form MO-1040. Missouri uses 8 progressive tax brackets ranging from 0% to 4.7%. Standard deductions: Single $15,750, MFJ $31,500, HOH $23,625. Starting with federal AGI, applies standard deduction based on filing status, then calculates tax using progressive brackets with cumulative approach.

initial_action.action_dsl: add "MISSOURI FORM MO-1040 - State Income Tax Calculation" to job.audit_trail; set result.mo_agi = result.agi; set result.mo_tax = 0
initial_action.action_postfix: "MISSOURI FORM MO-1040 - State Income Tax Calculation" job.audit_trail swap addto result.agi /result.mo_agi xdef 0 /result.mo_tax xdef
